content:
Leo has done lots of work recently on making tools for algebraic normalization available at a language level. These had previously existed as internals for grind, but now have a public API usable separately. Mostly this hasn't landed yet outside nightly, and we need to wait for the release candidate in about two weeks.

I am keen, when this all arrives, to start using it everywhere. I think it will be faster, it will provide a more uniform experience for tactic writers, and it opens up the opportunity to pass preparsed algebraic expressions between different meta components. All lovely things as we start doing more computer algebra in Lean.

I will make sure that when features are missing, we generalize and improve the upstream tools.

As a very first step (which we can do already on the current release candidate), #44469 is a -220+70 PR that rips out a bunch of custom Expr parsing in linarith, replacing it with "standard components" from lean4. I think it shouldn't result in behavioural changes, and only be faster.
!bench now reports that it is happy.
@Bhavik Mehta @Heather Macbeth, encouraging you both to take a look at this.
Also @Rob Lewis who I think is the original author of this code.
